thread:
sam (ux): Dropping a compact proposal for the latency page: fold heatmap to a sparkline at <=600px, add a tiny p95 comparator badge, and a sampling slider with a live "detection power" micro-stat. Mock: https://img.redwood.internal/tmp/compact-latency.png :sparkles:

morgan (product): Love the compactness. Two asks: keep Last 1h/24h/7d presets + custom quick-toggle, and default sampling = 100% for new orgs (avoid surprise costs).

drew (eng): Default 100% is fine. Implementation: when folding request coarser buckets server-side to reduce payload. Also debounce scrubber drag events (150ms) and only fetch immediately on snap or mouseup to avoid backend spam.

anya (a11y): A11y notes: presets must be keyboard-focusable with aria-pressed. Heatmap/sparkline cells need focus targets and aria-labels like "14:05 - p95 312ms, 120 reqs". Color-only intensity fails WCAG  add pattern overlay or numeric tooltip. Simulate modal must provide plain-text results and announce progress to screen readers.

sam (ux): Will add pattern overlay toggle, increase hit targets to 44px, and show a low-sample warning pill when <20%: "Low sampling may miss rare spikes". Auto-suggest toggle is ok but default off.

morgan (product): Also add a tiny help tooltip: "Lower sampling reduces cost but may underrepresent rare spikes." Link to docs and a quick simulate button (100/50/10/1%).

drew (eng): For simulate: cache per-org results (12h) and cap to 7d by default. Auto-suggest should be capped min 1% unless org opts into 0.5%. I'll add feature flag and telemetry hooks (simulate_run, sampling_accepted, baseline_pinned).

ci-bot: Checklist created: debounce=150ms, default_sampling=100%, pattern_overlay=true, simulate_cache=12h, a11y_audit_in_progress.

sam (ux): Next steps: update prototype with pinned baseline, detection-power micro-stat, CI band for p95, and annotated a11y notes. Posting updated link in ~90m. :thumbsup:
